nodes.text: Mind the dips, they are still soft. You have the look of somebody off the road. Sit, the smell is friendlier than it seems.
Now then. What can I light for you?

choices.text: Where do all these candles go?

nodes.text: Every road lamp from our gate to the Glasswater burns Hartfell tallow. A barrel a week just for the Hartway. The shrine flame lights them, mind. We only feed them. There is a difference and the Waykeepers will explain it at length.
The runs are empty and Swein triple counts the folds. Orvar came back from the stones with a face I did not like. And the buyer asked the moot again and got tea again. Poor man. Lovely manners.
Dips, tapers, lamp fill, and wicks that do not lie about their length. Light is cheap here. Dark is what costs.
Take a taper for the walk. Pay me next time, everyone does.
